definitions.mean_error_bias: Arithmetic mean of signed prediction errors
definitions.deviation_from_mean_error: Each signed error minus the mean signed error
definitions.error_variance: Mean squared deviation from mean error; population variance (ddof=0)
definitions.error_std: Square root of population error variance (ddof=0)
definitions.absolute_error_p95: 95th percentile of absolute errors using linear interpolation
definitions.R2: 1 - sum(squared errors) / sum((actual - mean(actual))**2); null for constant actuals
definitions.WAPE_percent: 100 * sum(absolute errors) / sum(abs(actual)); null for an all-zero actual series
definitions.exact_prediction_count: Number of predictions with exactly zero error; no rounding or tolerance
definitions.units: Rental counts, except MSE/variance (squared counts), R2 (unitless), WAPE (percent), and counts of samples
definitions.aggregation: Only observed eligible test targets; absent hours are not filled. Totals cover these targets only.
definitions.hourly_errors: Grouped by hour of day (0-23) across all test dates, not consecutive hourly bins
definitions.training_history: loss/val_loss are MSE in scaled target units; mae/val_mae are scaled MAE
